title: Persona record
description: Create a record called Persona with two fields: nombre (String) and edad (int). Then create instances and use the automatic methods toString, equals and componentN to print the information.
hints: Syntax: record Persona(String nombre, int edad) {}
Records automatically generate constructor, getters (nombre()), toString, equals, hashCode
Getters are named the same as the field: persona.nombre() not persona.getNombre()
solutionExplanation: The record replaces the need to write constructor, toString, equals and hashCode. Fields are accessed with nombre() and edad() (not getNombre). toString generates: Persona[nombre=Ana, edad=25].
expectedOutput:
Persona[nombre=Ana, edad=25]
Persona[nombre=Luis, edad=30]
Name p1: Ana
Age p2: 30
Are equal: false

title: Record with validation
description: Create a record Producto with nombre (String) and precio (double). Use a compact constructor to validate that the price is greater than 0 and that the name is not null or empty. Throw IllegalArgumentException if the validation fails.
hints: The compact constructor is written without parameters: Producto { ... }
In the compact constructor it validates BEFORE the fields are assigned
solutionExplanation: The compact constructor runs before the field assignment. It validates nombre (not null nor empty) and precio (greater than 0). If it fails, it throws IllegalArgumentException before creating the record.
expectedOutput:
Producto[nombre=Laptop, precio=999.99]
Producto[nombre=Mouse, precio=25.5]
Price error: Price must be greater than 0
Name error: Name cannot be null or empty

title: Nested records
description: Create two records: Direccion (String calle, String ciudad) and Persona (String nombre, int edad, Direccion direccion). Create people with different addresses, print the full info and create a method that returns the city of a Persona.
hints: Records are nested: Persona has a field of type Direccion
The nested toString shows: Persona[nombre=..., direccion=Direccion[calle=..., ciudad=...]]
solutionExplanation: Nested records allow composing data structures. Persona contains Direccion as a field. To access nested data the getter methods are chained: p.direccion().ciudad(). The toString is generated automatically for both records.
expectedOutput:
Persona[nombre=Ana, edad=25, direccion=Direccion[calle=Av. Principal, ciudad=Lima]]
Persona[nombre=Luis, edad=30, direccion=Direccion[calle=Calle 5, ciudad=Cusco]]
City of Ana: Lima
City of Luis: Cusco
Street of Luis: Calle 5
